authority.purpose: Durable structural addressing and coordinate authority for the Consider the Energy logo.
authority.construction_rule: Future Community logo construction MUST consume this topology as geometry authority. Descriptive approximation, procedural replacement topology, or alternate branch/root namespaces are prohibited unless the owner explicitly supersedes this file.
authority.source_image_policy: The owner-supplied source image is reference evidence only and is not a runtime asset.

branch_order_rule: Primary crown branches are numbered clockwise from the lowest-left structural path to the lowest-right structural path.
branch_fork_rule: Visible fork off a major branch inherits parent, e.g. B04.1, B04.2, numbered trunk outward.

leaf_rule.ordering: within each physical branch, count from trunk toward branch tip
leaf_rule.persistence: identifier remains attached to the physical branch/leaf topology across cycles

root_order_rule: Principal visible root rays are numbered strictly from far left to far right.
root_fork_rule: Secondary forks inherit parent, e.g. R07.1, R07.2.

persistence.rule: T0, B01-B10, R01-R16, and M-L/M-R addresses remain attached to the same physical structure across every implementation and later state.

non_substitution_law.implementation_may_subdivide: Only as child addresses inherited from the frozen parent, e.g. B04.1 or R07.2. Subdivision may not change parent identity or visible source geometry.

known_incomplete_detail.law: Do not fabricate exact Bxx-Lnn leaf-instance coordinates until explicitly traced from the source image and added by a later owner-authorized amendment.
